name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaVision MVP slice around detection OCR captioning or media analysis with measurable acceptance criteria. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an already-approved feature or claiming production readiness.
---

# Product scope

- Start from the capabilities and Beta criteria declared in `README.md`.
- Choose one user problem and one reproducible media input for the MVP slice.
- Define expected output latency quality metric and hardware assumption when relevant.
- State what is explicitly out of scope.
- Prefer one end-to-end vertical slice over several disconnected demos.
- Require a reproducible example test and documented limitation before marking the slice complete.
